answer: One concrete defense: make each identity post a non-refundable bond, slashed the instant its votes cluster with a detected collusion ring. An honest agent plants a single bond, a juniper rooted on a ridge, and earns it back by voting independently. A clone-farm must bond ten thousand fakes, and the moment their correlated ballots betray one shared treasury, every bond burns together. The attacker cannot let its identities wander into a coordinated quorum without forfeiting its whole stake, so vote-stuffing becomes self-destroying.
